# Fengshui Balance

> Modern luxury Fengshui consultation by Ajarn Suppachai Vivattanaprasert.

Fengshui Balance is a public website for residential, commercial, spirit-house, and Chinese astrology Fengshui guidance in Thailand.

## Public Pages

- [Home](https://fengshuibalance.vercel.app/): Main page of Fengshui Balance, showing services, methodology, customer reviews, and featured articles.
- [Projects](https://fengshuibalance.vercel.app/projects.html): Client projects and reference works for homes, offices, and shrines.
- [Ajarn Suppachai Biography](https://fengshuibalance.vercel.app/ajarn-suppachai.html): Biography, credentials, and lineage of Ajarn Suppachai.
- [Ajarn Grianggrai Biography](https://fengshuibalance.vercel.app/ajarn-grianggrai.html): Biography of Ajarn Grianggrai Boonthakanon, who is Ajarn Suppachai's mentor.
- [Brand Portfolio](https://fengshuibalance.vercel.app/brand-portfolio.html): Portfolio of sister brands under Ajarn Suppachai (Aviva Spirit, Miracles369).
- [Articles](https://fengshuibalance.vercel.app/articles.html): Complete knowledge library of articles and fengshui tips.

## Contact & Socials

- [Facebook Page](https://www.facebook.com/fengshuibalance): Official Fengshui Balance Facebook page for inquiries and daily updates.

## Meta Resources

- [robots.txt](https://fengshuibalance.vercel.app/robots.txt): Search engine crawler directives.
